_note: Population is the PSA 2024 Census of Population (POPCEN) figure (independently confirmed via PIA and palawan-news reporting on PSA data), up from 38,736 in the 2020 census. Land area and income classification are from the 2020 census via PhilAtlas (https://www.philatlas.com/luzon/mimaropa/palawan/aborlan.html) — note some sources (e.g. older LGU material) list Aborlan as 2nd class rather than 1st class; PSA's own income-classification list is the tiebreaker if this ever needs re-verifying. Registered voters figure is from COMELEC-sourced 2025 election reporting (Rappler).
